PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — PREPARED AT THE REQUEST OF COUNSEL

MEMORANDUM

To: Project Falcon Deal Team
From: Rachel Liu, Managing Director, Harrowgate Partners LLC
Date: February 3, 2025
Re: Project Falcon — fairness considerations for Northwind Traders Inc.

1. Our client, Northwind Traders Inc. (NASDAQ: NWTR), has entered into an agreement with Fabrikam Holdings to acquire Tailspin Logistics, a private carrier based at 2200 Harbor Drive, Tacoma, Washington 98421.

2. Northwind's CFO, Marcus Bell, asked us to confirm the $412.5 million purchase price, or $38.20 per share for 10,800,000 shares. Mr. Bell's brother-in-law sits on the Tailspin board.

3. Escrow funds will be held at JPMorgan Chase in account 4471-993012 until closing on March 14, 2025. Questions: rliu@harrowgatepartners.com or (206) 555-0142.

4. For context, Contoso Ltd. (NYSE: CTSO) reports 35M customers in its most recent 10-K; it is not a party to the transaction.

5. We recommend settling the Tailspin warranty dispute before signing. Our view of the client's exposure is $9.75M.

/s/ Rachel Liu
